world_model_content.rule: each trial's saved compiled world model in this run against the other run's, as the SHA-256 of its bytes with the probe's per-process scene folder (gof_probes/_scenes/p<process id>) replaced by one placeholder

readings.name: trials compared
readings.meaning: trials (one body, one goal) present in both runs for the bodies this run covers
readings.baseline: the other run holds 40 such trials

readings.name: values compared
readings.meaning: numbers and words of the other run's the controller arm, start, goal and command-state values compared one by one, timing keys excluded
readings.baseline: every value of every compared row

readings.name: values that differ
readings.meaning: 0 = this run reproduces the other run exactly (floating-point equality); any other count names the keys that differ in differing_keys

readings.name: trials whose saved world model content differs
readings.meaning: 0 = every compared trial's compiled world model has the same bytes as the other run's once the per-process scene folder in its texture paths is replaced by one placeholder
readings.baseline: 40 trials compared from 16 saved model files
